title: Prognosis and Interdependence of heart Rhythm and AtrioveNtricular Heart vAlve regurgitation in patients undergoing rhythm control therapy or interventional valve treatment
summary: Ziel der Studie ist es, ein besseres Verständnis für die Wechselwirkungen zwischen Vorhofflimmern und AV-Klappeninsuffizienzen zu entwickeln.  Hierzu sollen Patient*innen untersucht werden, bei denen eine mindestens mittelgradige Insuffizienz einer Atrioventrikularklappe (Mitral- oder Trikuspidalklappe) vorliegt. Patient*innen werden entweder einer rhythmusstabilisierenden Therapie (Elektrobehandlung oder Verödungstherapie der Lungengefäße (Pulmonalvenenisolation) ) oder kathetergestützten Reparatur der AV-Klappeninsuffizienz unterzogen. Im Rahmen eines 6- und 12-monatigen Follow-Ups werden AV-Klappeninsuffizienz und Herzrhythmus untersucht.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
2.	Written informed consent for study participation prior to enrollment (only applicable for prospective study part)
3.	Ability to understand the nature of the trial and the trial related procedures and to comply with them (only applicable for prospective study part)
4.	≥ moderate MR or TR
Additional criterion for the rhythm control group: 
1.	A diagnosis of persistent AFib or atypical atrial flutter and an applied rhythm control (EC/CA) during baseline visit
Exclusion criteria:
1.	Prior cardiac surgery, left atrial catheter ablation 
2.	Patients with primary MR/TR 
3.	Patients with secondary MR/TR due to endocarditis
4.	Short life expectancy due to comorbid conditions
5.	Severe aortic valvulopathy (≥ Grade 3)
6.	Acute inflammatory or infectious disease 
7.	Implant of CRT or CRT-D within the last 30 days
8.	CIED related TR
Additional Exclusion criterion for the rhythm control group (group 1)
1.	Prior transcatheter edge-to-edge repair of MR/TR
Additional Exclusion criterion for the TEER group (group 2)
1.	Applied rhythm control (CA or EC) during baseline stay
